run_when: Code found waitlist or early-access wording and no pricing or checkout.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company is pre-revenue with minimal operating activity (the 'explorer' pattern).
prompt.definition: This lowers the score but never disqualifies. Converts at the lowest rate and belongs in self-serve.
yes_when: Waitlist, early access or beta sign-up only, with no pricing, checkout or customers
no_when: Paid plans, checkout, customers or open jobs exist
watch_out_for: A free tier with paid upgrades is not pre-revenue

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

examples.input_excerpt: Join the waitlist for early access. Launching 2026.

output.evidence_quote: Join the waitlist for early access.
output.reason: Only a waitlist, no paid offering.
